description: Experiment-only dedicated PC Gaming route. Normal production routing remains unchanged unless passed via --experiment-overrides.

gaming.pc_gaming.subject: A focused PC gamer wearing plain headphones actively plays using a generic full-size keyboard and mouse beside one visible unbranded desktop tower, with hands, seated posture, and reaction communicating active computer gaming while the entire monitor zone stays outside the frame
gaming.pc_gaming.environment: A believable home PC-gaming corner with a seated player, generic desktop tower, full-size keyboard, mouse, mouse mat, headphones, chair, and simple room details; no monitor, television, laptop, tablet, phone, projector, display panel, gameplay screen, or other screen-bearing device anywhere
gaming.pc_gaming.composition: The dedicated PC-play scene must be carried by the player, desktop tower, keyboard, mouse, headphones, active hands, seated posture, and focused gaming reaction. Do not depict building, repairing, assembling, coding, streaming, or presenting an object. Crop before the monitor zone.
gaming.pc_gaming.camera: Low side three-quarter medium shot showing player, keyboard, mouse, headphones, and desktop tower together while excluding the entire display area.
recognition_anchors_add: full-size keyboard and mouse actively used for play
focused seated gaming posture and reaction
must_include_add: active hands on keyboard and mouse
zero screen-bearing devices anywhere in frame
override_prompt_additions: This is a dedicated screenless PC-gaming scene, not a collectible-object build and not streaming. The player is already gaming. Do not place any gadget in the player's hands other than normal keyboard/mouse interaction, and do not invent a screen.
